title: Bagong automation para kay Ms. Anne
items: Araw-araw na 8:00 AM: isang Telegram update bawat active/pending na client (status, huling galaw, at nakabinbin).
Sample retrieval: alerto kapag DP bayad na ang client, o 2 linggo (14 araw) nang walang galaw ang client.
Feature announcements: makakatanggap ka ng alerto tuwing may bagong feature o automation na ina-deploy.
